text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help Kawakami Princess get used to 
racing, even after her debut race, I had 
her participate in mock races alongside 
regular ones.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Phew~...!
choice_data_list: Your running is much better than before!
Your running is much better than before!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, is that true!? Then I would gladly 
welcome another race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Phew... haah... W-Wait. Give me a break...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>. We are both in the Junior Class, 
so pushing beyond this would be...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I learned a lot myself. I look 
forward to next time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uggh... But I'm full of energy... And I 
was just about to get the hang of it, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there are no opponents left to 
actually compete against today... So with 
that said.
choice_data_list:
Maybe I should do some visualization 
training

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Mental training?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... This is an 18-horse race. 
Right now, there are 16 ahead of me...
choice_data_list: Focus! They're closing in from behind!
Focus! They're closing in from behind!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ngh... hah... hah... N-Nggghhh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, I'm the only one here, though?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Simulating the real race is all well and 
good, but running alone is still running 
alone! A duel is a clash of sweat and 
sheer spirit—a race without that is 
just...!
choice_data_list:
Didn't we have that kind of training in 
PuriFai too?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!? C-Could that possibly be... the 
Imaginary Race from Episode 22, where 
PreFie competes against 50 imaginary 
versions of herself...?!
choice_data_list:
If you can do that too, you'll become even 
stronger.

If you can do that too, you'll become even 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: M-Mmh...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Mumble, mumble. The ribbon girl in this 
race is... mumble, mumble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since, Kawakami Princess had been 
watching race footage of other Umamusume 
as a reference for image training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fuhee~... That finishes the sixth lap~.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's nothing quite like watching 
a race live. The resolve to crush each 
other into dust. The roaring crowd going 
wild, and...
choice_data_list:
Then shall we go watch an actual race next 
time?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeh~~~lizabeth Queen Cup, you say~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I brought Kawakami Princess 
along to spectate the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup held in Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer?! Is this the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaaaa!! Princess of princesses! The 
stage to decide the Queen! I will run in 
this race one day too, I swear it~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess got more excited than 
anticipated, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Visiting in person will surely prove 
useful to her.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which Umamusume will be crowned 
Queen?! A total of 18 Umamusume are 
entering the track!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaaaaaah--!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And next, having mowed down a field of 
giants in the Takarazuka Kinen, comes this 
girl! Sweep Tosho has also appeared on the 
turf.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Sweep! Let's get into the gate 
quickly today, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly. The demographic of youngsters 
coming to the Queen Elizabeth II Cup has 
really changed, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Madam Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~... *sigh* If she's running too, I 
just hope it won't be a repeat of the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the race that started that day... 
turned into a nail-biting showdown.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The leader makes a magnificent bid for a 
wire-to-wire win. Will the queen's throne 
finally be hers?! But coming from the 
outside—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...Sweep Tosho! Here comes Sweep Tosho 
making her move from the outside!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Neck and neck! They're side by side! Sweep 
Tosho charging furiously from the outside! 
Sweep Tosho takes first... it's first 
place!!

text_block_list.name: Blonde Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaaaa!! As expected of Sweep! You're 
totally doing it, you're crazy strooong!

text_block_list.name: Blue-Haired Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Damn, that late-stage burst. So freaking 
cool. Come on, Sweep, win the next one 
too!

text_block_list.name: Madam Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems everything went well this 
time, including the gate-in. But—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Did you see that? That's my true 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho-san, that was an incredible 
run! Could we get a word on how you feel 
right now?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I don't even have one word for you! 
Later!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Sweep Tosho?! Sweep Tosho-saaan?!

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
"Judging by how she's acting, she's still 
a spoiled princess. I hope next year she 
shows the growth befitting a queen, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...So this is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. 
The fierce battle of the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I will—I will definitely win on that 
stage too! I shall become the Queen!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please... please! Train me right 
this instant, if you will!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The Academy, of course!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We hurried back to the academy after 
that... and somehow managed to squeeze in 
before the track's operating hours ended.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess enters the gate as well. 
And now, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup is 
about to—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: *Clunk!*

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It has beguuuuun!! Hnnngh~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems tonight's mental training is 
already modeled after the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup. However, unlike last time—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hiiii-yaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even practicing alone, she's staying 
mindful of the real 'race' ahead."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I will too... I will, too! 
Someday, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"If I win at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, I 
can become the ideal princess, can't I?!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: All riiiight! I'm gonna do thiiiiiisssss!!
